guidance.statement: Suyog Urja expected FY26 revenue of ₹355 Cr and PAT of ₹38 Cr
Suyog Urja cumulative PAT target of ₹175 Cr for FY26 to FY28
FY27 revenue of around ₹2,000 crores with PAT margin around 13.5% to 14%

industry: Utilities > Other Utilities > Water Supply & Management

operating_notes.text: PRA Bihar Bess BESS project tariff agreed at ₹4,44,000/MW/month for 12 years with BSPHCL, NBPDCL, and SBPDCL, backed by VGF of up to ₹27 lakh/MWh.
EIE Renewables signed SPA to acquire 100% of Suyog Urja for ~₹311 Cr (51% immediately, 49% within 27 months).
Suyog Urja has over 500 MW projects executed, ₹645 Cr order book, and FY25 turnover of ₹171.99 Cr.
Suyog Urja operates an asset-light, zero-debt model with PAT margins above 11%.
Group IPP portfolio comprises 79 MW solar and 150 MWh BESS.
Received ₹113.51 Cr LoA for Santalpur Taluka Lift Irrigation scheme in Gujarat (24 months EPC + 10 years O&M).
Q4FY26 monitoring agency report shows ₹461.53 Cr cumulative utilization of IPO net proceeds.
Suyog Urja Limited secured a ₹207.47 Cr hybrid renewable energy BoP contract to be executed by June 30, 2027.
Total order book reached over ₹6,814 crores, providing revenue visibility for 24 months.

Suyog Urja Limited, a step-down subsidiary, received an LOI from ARIE ENERGY LLP for ₹228.00 Cr (excluding GST) of EPC turnkey works on a 100 MW wind project in Latur, Maharashtra, to be executed by 31 July 2027.
Suyog Urja Limited received a ₹228 Cr (excl. GST) LOI from ARIE Energy LLP for EPC turnkey works on the 100 MW Ajani wind project in Latur, Maharashtra, to be executed by 31 July 2027.

timeline.summary: Subsidiary EIE Renewables acquired 49% in PRA Bihar Bess for ₹15.51 Cr with options for to build a 37.5 MW / 150 MWh BESS project.
Subsidiary EIE Renewables signed a SPA to acquire 100% of Suyog Urja for ~₹311 Cr, adding a ₹645 Cr wind EPC order book.
Enviro Infra Engineers detailed its ₹311 Cr acquisition of Suyog Urja, pushing consolidated group order book to ~₹5,600 Cr.
Enviro Infra Engineers bagged a ₹113.51 Cr (excl. GST) EPC and 10-year O&M lift irrigation order from Sardar Sarovar Narmada Nigam Limited.
Sanjay Jain, Promoter & Director, declared no encumbrance on shares by Promoters & Concert Parties by March 31, 2026.
Enviro Infra Engineers received a favourable arbitral award of ₹8.65 crore against HSIIDC for the Faridabad and Rohtak CETP projects.
Enviro Infra Engineers filed its Q4FY26 monitoring agency report on May 15, 2026, showing ₹461.53 Cr utilized out of ₹517.27 Cr IPO net proceeds.
Enviro Infra Engineers' step-down subsidiary Suyog Urja Limited won a ₹207.47 Cr hybrid renewable energy BoP contract.
Enviro Infra Engineers Limited’s management, led by Piyush Jain, held a conference call on 29 May 2026 to discuss Q4FY26 and FY26 results with investors.
Enviro Infra Engineers held its Q4 and FY26 earnings call on May 29, 2026, reporting ₹1,145.6 Cr revenue and guiding for ₹2,000 Cr in FY27.

Suyog Urja Limited, step-down subsidiary of Enviro Infra Engineers, received an LOI dated 14 Oct 2026 from ARIE ENERGY LLP for ₹228.00 Cr (excl. GST) EPC works on the 100 MW Ajani wind project in Latur, Maharashtra, to be executed by 31 July 2027.

Suyog Urja Limited, EIEL's subsidiary, received a ₹228 Cr (excl. GST) LOI from ARIE Energy LLP for EPC turnkey works on the 100 MW Ajani wind project in Latur, Maharashtra, to be executed by 31 July 2027.

watchlist.response: Order execution and evaluation processes got elongated, and new projects remained in the design stage. Furthermore, margin impact was due to project mix and higher employee/other expenses.
watchlist.text: Why did the company miss its FY26 revenue growth guidance and why did Q4 margins compress?

watchlist.response: Funds from AMRUT projects were delayed from the center across several states, increasing unbilled revenue days. Funds are now getting released, and we expect normalization.
watchlist.text: Working capital has stretched significantly to 166 days. What is the outlook?
